prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Caring for Your Pet", "Try feeding and interacting with your companion before launching it to your desktop.", "Give Starter Treat", "Pet Care Essentials", "Click treats or double click your pet anytime to bring up quick care controls.", "Complete Setup"]
1: ["Managing Your Desktop Companion", "Learn how to show, hide, and move your desktop pet at any time.", "Start Pet Companion"]
2: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet", "We are generating your unique companion traits and desktop animations."]
3: ["Select Your Ideal Companion Experience", "Pick between relaxed desktop companionship or active adventure mode."]
4: ["Review Companion Features", "Verify your pet features look accurate before generating your official certificate.", "Looks Great"]
5: ["Preparing Companion Traits", "Your pet is being customized for your desktop setup."]
6: ["Your Pet Is Saved to Your Account", "Your companion progress is automatically synced so you never lose your pet.", "Cloud Account Connected", "Launch to Desktop"]
7: ["Discover Companion Modes", "Choose how your desktop pet will fit into your everyday computer use.", "Choose Your Path"]
8: ["Claim Your Official Adoption Certificate", "Select a celebratory seal to mark your pet adoption day.", "Starter Seal", "Confirm & Continue"]
9: ["Keep Your Companion Handy", "Pin the companion icon to your taskbar so your pet is always one click away.", "Pin & Launch Desktop Pet"]
